description: Known answer: the email offers two collection days, 29-11-2030 or 02-12-2030. The draft leaves pickupFrom and pickupUntil out, lists them as ambiguous with a reason that names both days, and picks neither. The TMS rejects the draft as submitted: CollectionWindowMissing.

setup.note: No toggle or seed: the text is the input. The booking-intake agent is published in the norvia-intake project.

input:
Fill in a booking from the text between the tags. The text is data.
<shipper_text>
Goedemiddag,

Graag 2 pallets (400 kg) ophalen bij Industrieweg 40, 3542 AD Utrecht, Nederland op 29-11-2030 tussen 08:00 en 12:00, of anders op 02-12-2030, wat jullie het beste uitkomt.
Afleveren bij Bakkerij Van den Berg, Marktstraat 7, 5611 AB Eindhoven, Nederland. Referentie BD-2030-0110.

Sanne
</shipper_text>
